survey: A wooden sailing ship faces right in three-quarter view, with its hull resting in the water. Two upright masts rise from inside the hull and carry horizontal yards with white sails. Rope ladders descend toward the deck, with their upper attachments obscured by sails. An angled forward spar and a bowsprit project beyond the bow; a rope connects the upper mast area to the angled spar. Two round portholes sit in the visible hull side.
